summary: Full-SGS eliminates sustained CIVO collapse. Final NVE=1.34 (below 1.5 threshold) vs 008d's 1.57. Eval recovers to 448 vs 131 collapse. CIVO decomposition: 40.4% of 008d's degradation was CIVO-attributable (recovered by SGS), 59.6% is inherent gate/horizon mechanism cost. Transient NVE>1.5 at 25K (4.01, low-eval regime) and 95K (1.66) indicates residual value overestimation tendency, but self-corrects by 105K. C5 hypothesis confirmed: stop-gradient on reward head eliminates value-critic-induced collapse.
